name: MealNova India Nutrition Validation Pack
purpose: Level 2.2 bridge from weak estimated Indian nutrition references to source-backed production references.
critical_rule: No provisional value in this file is a validated replacement. Do not overwrite production nutrition until production_approved=true after source/recipe validation.

accuracy_goal.food_name_recognition: >=90-95% top-1 on a diverse held-out benchmark
accuracy_goal.calories: >=90% of benchmark cases within ±20%; stretch goal >=80% within ±15% where portion/preparation are observable
accuracy_goal.macros: >=85-90% within ±20% where recipe and portion are sufficiently observable
accuracy_goal.note: Do not claim 95% exact calorie accuracy for visually ambiguous mixed dishes.

authoritative_source_policy.role: Primary Indian composition source for raw/base foods and ingredients
authoritative_source_policy.important_limitation: Most IFCT food values are for raw foods, so cooked mixed dishes require recipe/yield calculations.

authoritative_source_policy.role: Secondary cross-check for ingredients and prepared-food analogues
authoritative_source_policy.important_limitation: Do not substitute a US analogue when an Indian recipe materially differs.

authoritative_source_policy.role: Preferred for exact branded/menu item matches
authoritative_source_policy.important_limitation: Never generalize one brand's nutrition to a generic Indian dish.

calculation_spec.per_100g_recipe: sum(nutrient amount contributed by every ingredient) / final cooked yield_g * 100
calculation_spec.oil_rule: Use retained oil/ghee, not merely oil added to pan, when recipe evidence supports a retention assumption.
calculation_spec.yield_rule: Final cooked weight must be recorded; water gain/loss is essential to per-100g accuracy.
calculation_spec.range_rule: Store low/central/high for recipe-variable foods; widen range when oil, sugar, filling or preparation is visually uncertain.
calculation_spec.portion_rule: Keep portion estimation separate from per-100g nutrition so photo-size errors can be measured independently.

integration_rules: Only production_approved=true records may override existing production nutrition.
Keep recognition confidence, portion confidence and nutrition confidence as separate signals.
When confidence is low, show a range or ask a lightweight clarification instead of false precision.
